title: US Orders Ban On Chinese AI Technology Deepseek From Federal IT Systems Over Security Fears
description: The US Department of Homeland Security ordered federal civilian agencies to remove DeepSeek products, and any third-party services built on its AI models, from their systems. Agencies are barred from buying DeepSeek offerings, including those from affiliates. DHS cited national security risks, warning of possible data transfers to China and potential malware or vulnerabilities.
